clips.title: The story
paras: A trade has been worked out with the Dun Garok brew-kin, who miss the Fallrook family's vineyards as much as anyone. A case of Fallrook Varietal travels to their fort in the southeast of Hillsbrad Foothills, and a sack of their Homebrew Hops comes back.

Most of the best bottled years of Fallrook wine are long since drunk, but cases of the Fallrook Varietal still sit in the cellars. The Dun Garok brew-kin miss the vineyards of the Fallrook family too, and a trade has been worked out with them.
The case goes southeast to Dun Garok, to be left with the brew-kin beside the fireplace where they gather, down at the base of their fort. In return, you carry a sack of their Homebrew Hops back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars.
Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.
In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.
That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
